gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-biz-udgothic: Wobbly, friendly, hand-drawn energy. Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width throughout, while BIZ UDGothic stays modern and professional, with wide channels opening into every bowl.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-biz-udpgothic: Shantell Sans draws every stroke with a constant pen width, from top to baseline, with mouths as wide as a cut tin lid. And BIZ UDPGothic follows with generous letter spacing and clear channels leading into each round letter.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-st: Shantell Sans is distinctive and expressive, with a flat line weight in every letter. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std settles into a neutral, approachable sans with connected counters and a slight tug of heavier verticals, which keeps extended reading smooth and unhurried.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-cairo-play: Expressive and loose, Shantell Sans holds a steady pen pressure from its first letter to its last. Cairo Play sits beside it in a modern, professional manner, its open round letters staying readable at small sizes while the heading plays.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-dotgothic16: Shantell Sans brings a wide-mouthed, hand-drawn look. DotGothic16 follows with tube-like strokes and wide channels into each counter, so try the heading generous and the body modest in size.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-expa: Loose, skimming, unmistakably hand-drawn. Shantell Sans is best at casual personality from its unchanging stroke, while Encode Sans Expanded does its best work in neutral, approachable text with its c shapes pulled well apart.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Expressive curves, rope-thick and round. Shantell Sans sets the mood, then Encode Sans SC steps in with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps, giving the page a professional, neutral footing.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-exo: No brush-style swell appears anywhere in Shantell Sans, just a fixed nib width and wide, open mouths. And Exo carries the text in an approachable, clean plain sans, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-faculty-glyphic: Shantell Sans replaces thin hairline joins with full-width stroke connections, giving its letters a chunky, marker-drawn feel. Faculty Glyphic reads modern and professional, with clear openings in its rounded sans letters.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-finlandica: Shantell Sans brings its wide-mouthed, fixed-nib looseness to the top of the page, a distinctive and expressive start. Finlandica keeps the text contemporary and clean, with open e crossbars.
